_comment: Single place for every outbound link AERIS Music uses. A link that is empty is omitted from the video descriptions, so the block degrades cleanly until K fills the affiliate id in.
_shopee_links_comment: Per-surface s.shopee.co.th links minted 2026-11-02 from the affiliate dashboard (account navintas) via the Custom Link tool, each tagged with its Sub_id. A th.shp.ee short link strips sub_id, so only these give per-surface attribution. Empty falls back to shopee_affiliate.
